description: Indexes the project's pictures for search_media. Usually not needed: indexing is automatic and this only nudges the queue to re-check now. When the user switched automatic indexing off, this asks for every video and image to be indexed. Returns the same payload as get_analysis_status.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: start_visual_indexing
title: Start picture indexing
